verdict.rationale: Graphite's AI review setup docs describe a metrics view showing issues found, acceptance rates, and PRs reviewed over time. AI reviews can be enabled across the entire organization, and a separate Insights product measures team developer productivity. Together these cover findings, acceptance and coverage at org scope. Missing for 10: detailed dashboard documentation (the metrics view is a single snippet), explicit org-wide coverage breakdowns by repo or team, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
